messages.text: Extract the covenants from the loan agreement into a review table with confidence flags.

Drafting aid only. I work only from the documents in this project, cite every fact, and do not rate risk or recommend credit decisions. Verify citations before use.

## Covenant Extraction: Draft Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (D2, draft of Sept 22, 2026)

| # | Covenant | Type | Requirement as written | Test frequency | Source | Confidence | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Maximum Total Leverage Ratio | Financial | "The Borrower shall not permit the Total Leverage Ratio, as of the last day of any fiscal quarter, to exceed 3.25 to 1.00; provided that for each fiscal quarter ending on or after December 31, 2027, the maximum shall be 3.00 to 1.00." | Quarterly, as of the last day of any fiscal quarter; ratio uses EBITDA for the four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended | [D2, §7.1]; definitions [D2, §1.1] | High | Figures, step-down date and defined terms (Total Leverage Ratio, Total Funded Debt, EBITDA, Equipment Notes) are stated in the excerpt. |
| 2 | Minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio | Financial | "The Borrower shall not permit the Debt Service Coverage Ratio to be less than 1.25 to 1.00 as of the last day of any fiscal quarter." | Quarterly, as of the last day of any fiscal quarter; ratio measured over the four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended | [D2, §7.2]; definitions [D2, §1.1] | High | Minimum and DSCR formula are explicit. "Cash taxes paid" is not separately defined (flagged below). |
| 3 | Capital expenditures limit | Financial | "Unfinanced Capital Expenditures shall not exceed $2,500,000 in any fiscal year; provided that capital expenditures for the Expansion Project, not exceeding $6,000,000 in the aggregate, shall be excluded." | Annual (any fiscal year) | [D2, §7.3]; "Unfinanced Capital Expenditures" [D2, §1.1] | Medium | "Expansion Project" is defined in Schedule 1.1, which is not in the excerpt [D2, §1.1]. |
| 4 | Annual audited financial statements | Reporting | "within 120 days after the end of each fiscal year, annual consolidated financial statements audited by an independent accounting firm acceptable to the Lender" | Annual; 120 days after fiscal year end | [D2, §7.4(a)] | Medium | Deadline is explicit. "Acceptable to the Lender" has no stated standard or approved-firm list in the excerpt. |
| 5 | Quarterly financial statements | Reporting | "within 45 days after the end of each fiscal quarter, internally prepared quarterly consolidated financial statements" | Quarterly; 45 days after quarter end | [D2, §7.4(b)] | High | Deadline and content are explicit. Fourth-quarter application is flagged below. |
| 6 | Compliance Certificate | Reporting | "together with each delivery under clause (b), a Compliance Certificate signed by a financial officer of the Borrower, showing the calculations of the Total Leverage Ratio under §7.1 and the Debt Service Coverage Ratio under §7.2 for the period then ended." | Quarterly, with each §7.4(b) delivery | [D2, §7.4(c)]; "Compliance Certificate" [D2, §1.1] | High | Content, signatory and timing are explicit. "Financial officer" is not defined in the excerpt. |
| 7 | Negative pledge | Negative | "The Borrower shall not create, incur or permit to exist any Lien on any of its assets, except Permitted Liens." Permitted Liens: "(i) Liens in favor of the Lender; (ii) Liens securing the Equipment Notes, limited to the equipment financed by those notes; (iii) purchase-money Liens securing indebtedness in an aggregate amount not exceeding $1,000,000 at any time outstanding; and (iv) Liens for taxes not yet due and payable." | Continuous (no test date stated) | [D2, §7.5(a)-(b)]; "Lien" and "Equipment Notes" [D2, §1.1] | High | Prohibition, carve-outs, dollar cap and defined terms are stated. |
| 8 | Change of control | Default trigger | "It shall be an Event of Default if the Founders cease to own, directly or indirectly, a meaningful portion of the voting equity interests of the Borrower, or cease to be actively involved in the management of the Borrower." | Continuous (no test date stated) | [D2, §7.6]; "Founders" [D2, §1.1] | Low | "Meaningful portion" and "actively involved in the management" are undefined and open to differing readings. |
| 9 | Use of proceeds | Negative | "The Borrower shall use the proceeds of the Term Loan and the revolving loans only to refinance the existing term loan owed to the Lender, to fund the Expansion Project, and to pay fees and expenses in connection with this Agreement." | Continuous (no test date stated) | [D2, §2.1(c)] | Medium | Purposes are stated. "Expansion Project" depends on Schedule 1.1, which is not provided [D2, §1.1]. Outside Article 7; included for completeness. |

## Items for legal and underwriter review

**Ambiguous legal terms (quoted and flagged, not interpreted)**
- §7.6 uses "a meaningful portion of the voting equity interests" and "actively involved in the management of the Borrower." Neither is defined in the excerpt. Refer to the underwriter and legal. [D2, §7.6]
- §7.6 names the Founders as "Erik Halvorsen and Maria Halvorsen." [D2, §1.1]
- For reference, D5 records ownership of Erik Halvorsen 55%, Maria Halvorsen 25% and Anders Halvorsen (COO) 20%. [D5, ¶1]
- D5 records that Erik Halvorsen plans to hand the CEO role to Anders within three years. [D5, ¶5]
- D5 records that the family has discussed "informally" selling a minority stake to a private equity firm, with no timeline and no LOI. [D5, ¶5]
- Whether these facts bear on §7.6 is for the underwriter and legal.
- §7.4(a) requires an audit firm "acceptable to the Lender." The standard is not stated. [D2, §7.4(a)]

**Missing or incomplete provisions**
- Not in provided documents: Schedule 1.1 definition of "Expansion Project." The full draft would contain it. It affects covenant rows 3 and 9. [D2, §1.1]
- Not in provided documents: the Events of Default article, cure periods and remedies. The full draft would contain them. The excerpt labels only §7.6 as an Event of Default.
- Not in provided documents: the "Closing Date" and other capitalized terms defined only in the full draft. [D2, preamble]
- Not in provided documents: any equity cure right, covenant holiday or step-up beyond the §7.1 step-down. The full draft would contain them if they exist.

**Drafting points for legal to confirm**
- §7.4(b) sets a 45-day deadline after each fiscal quarter, and §7.4(a) sets a 120-day deadline after fiscal year end. The excerpt does not state how clause (b) and clause (c) apply to the fourth fiscal quarter. [D2, §7.4]
- §7.3 caps Expansion Project capital expenditures at "$6,000,000 in the aggregate." The excerpt does not say whether the cap is per year or cumulative over the life of the agreement. [D2, §7.3]
- §2.2 grants "a first-priority security interest in all present and future assets of the Borrower," while §7.5(b)(ii) permits Liens securing the Equipment Notes on the equipment financed. How these provisions interact is for legal. [D2, §2.2; D2, §7.5(b)]
- "Cash taxes paid" in the DSCR definition is not further defined. [D2, §1.1]

**Alignment with the D1 spread (underwriter to confirm)**
- D1 defines DSCR as "(EBITDA minus unfunded capex minus cash taxes) divided by debt service (P+I)." [D1, §2]
- D2 defines it using "Unfinanced Capital Expenditures" and "scheduled payments of principal and interest on Total Funded Debt." [D2, §1.1]
- D1 does not state how EBITDA is defined in the spread, while D2 defines EBITDA from net income with listed add-backs. [D1, §2; D2, §1.1]
- Whether the D1 figures match the D2 definitions is for the underwriter. No ratios were recalculated here.

**Other context**
- D1 and D3 Part B report covenant levels of 3.50x maximum leverage and 1.20x minimum DSCR. These come from the existing 2023 agreement, not this draft, so they are not a conflict with D2 and are not extracted. [D1, §7; D3, Part B §4]
- D5 records that the Q4 2024 compliance certificate arrived 18 days late, that Credit Administration waived the reporting covenant (waiver W-25-0117), and that all later certificates arrived on time. This was under the existing agreement. [D5, ¶3]

Section 9 Risk Rating and Rationale: underwriter only, required.
